cinematic_dialogue:2:1525417002:.text: That must mean the God of Harvest is gone for good...
cinematic_dialogue:2:1525417002:.source_cn: 丰饶神应该彻底陨落了……

cinematic_dialogue:2:1525417004:.text: My... my house is still standing!

cinematic_dialogue:2:1525417006:.female: Well, that's one disaster dealt with.

say:4:1525418001:0.text: With the God of Harvest gone, the calamity is finally over.

say:5:1525418002:0.text: No more floods, no more locusts... the curse on those crops should be gone too.
